# Robinhood Lighter Docs Documentation > Documentation for Robinhood Lighter Docs Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version. ## Guides - [Get Started](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/get-started.md) - [Account Types](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/account-types.md) - [API Keys](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/api-keys.md) - [SDK](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/sdk.md) - [Rate Limits](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/rate-limits.md) - [Volume Quota](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/volume-quota.md) - [Signing Transactions](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/signing-transactions.md) - [WebSocket](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/websocket.md) - [Partner Attribution](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/partner-attribution.md) - [Deposits, Transfers, and Withdrawals](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/deposits-transfers-and-withdrawals.md) - [Data Structures, Constants and Errors](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/docs/data-structures-constants-and-errors.md) ## API Reference - [systemConfig](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/systemconfig.md): Get system config - [status](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/status.md): Get status of zklighter - [layer1BasicInfo](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/layer1basicinfo.md): Get zklighter l1 general info, including contract address and rpc info - [account](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/account-1.md): Get account by an account's index, or L1 address - [accountLimits](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/accountlimits.md): Get account limits. For more details on account types, see this page: https://apidocs.lighter.xyz/docs/account-types - [accountMetadata](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/accountmetadata.md): Get account metadatas - [accountsByL1Address](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/accountsbyl1address.md): Returns all accounts associated with the given L1 address - [changeAccountTier](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/changeaccounttier.md): Change account tier. You can only perform this action once every 24 hours, and with no orders or positions open. - [l1Metadata](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/l1metadata.md): Get L1 metadata - [liquidations](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/liquidations.md): Get liquidation infos - [pnl](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/pnl.md): Get account PnL chart - [positionFunding](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/positionfunding.md): Get accounts position fundings - [publicPoolsMetadata](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/publicpoolsmetadata.md): Get public pools metadata. `auth` is required in case you specify an account_index. You will see public pools with an index that starts an n-1 of the one you specify. To see staking pools, use `filter=stake` - [accountOrders](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/accountorders.md): Get account orders by client order indexes. Account index defaults to the authorization token's account. Supports the last 10K active orders (with no time limits), or the last 1K inactive orders (in the last 24 hours). - [accountActiveOrders](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/accountactiveorders.md): Get account active orders. `auth` can be generated using the SDK. - [accountInactiveOrders](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/accountinactiveorders.md): Get account inactive orders. `auth` can be generated using the SDK. - [export](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/export.md): Export trades and funding payments, limited to 12 months or 1M trades. END_TS_IN_MS - START_TS_IN_MS should not be larger than 12 months in milliseconds, both timestamps should be greater than or equal to 17 January 2025 00:00:00 UTC (lighter's mainnet genesis) - [assetDetails](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/assetdetails.md): Get asset details for a specific asset or all assets - [orderBookDetails](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/orderbookdetails.md): Get order books metadata - [orderBookOrders](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/orderbookorders.md): Get order book orders - [orderBooks](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/orderbooks.md): Get order books metadata.
**Response Description:**

1) **Taker and maker fees** are in percentage.
2) **Min base amount:** The amount of base token that can be traded in a single order.
3) **Min quote amount:** The amount of quote token that can be traded in a single order.
4) **Supported size decimals:** The number of decimal places that can be used for the size of the order.
5) **Supported price decimals:** The number of decimal places that can be used for the price of the order.
6) **Supported quote decimals:** Size Decimals + Quote Decimals. - [recentTrades](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/recenttrades.md): Get recent trades - [trades](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/trades.md): Get trades for lighter accounts, including sub-accounts and public pools. `auth` is required for master accounts and sub accounts. - [sendTx](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/sendtx.md): You need to sign the transaction body before sending it to the server. More details can be found here: https://apidocs.lighter.xyz/docs/get-started - [sendTxBatch](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/sendtxbatch.md): You need to sign the transaction body before sending it to the server. More details can be found here: https://apidocs.lighter.xyz/docs/get-started - [tx](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/tx.md): Get transaction by hash or sequence index - [txFromL1TxHash](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/txfroml1txhash.md): Get L1 transaction by L1 transaction hash - [deposit_history](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/deposit_history.md): Get deposit history - [transfer_history](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/transfer_history.md): Get transfer history. To fetch an account index, you will need to `auth` the request, unless it's a public pool. - [withdraw_history](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/withdraw_history.md): Get withdraw history. Secure withdrawals are only set to `claimable` when ready. You should only expect the `completed` status on fast withdrawals via Arbitrum. - [announcement](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/announcement-1.md): Get announcements - [apikeys](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/apikeys.md): Get account api key. Set `api_key_index` to 255 to retrieve all api keys associated with the account. - [nextNonce](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/nextnonce.md): Get next nonce for a specific account and api key - [tokens_create](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/tokens_create.md): Create an API token for read-only access - [tokens_revoke](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/tokens_revoke.md): Revoke read only auth token for an account - [tokens](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/tokens.md): Get read only auth tokens for an account - [setMakerOnlyApiKeys](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/setmakeronlyapikeys.md): Set maker-only API key indexes. This replaces the current list; pass all indexes you want marked as maker-only. Pass [] to clear all maker-only restrictions. - [getMakerOnlyApiKeys](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/getmakeronlyapikeys.md): Get maker-only API key indexes - [candles](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/candles.md): Get candles data. Returns at most 500 candles per call. Zero values are omitted from the response. - [markPriceCandles](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/markpricecandles.md): Get mark price candles - [marketPriceCharts](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/marketpricecharts.md): Get last 24h hourly prices for all markets (mark price for perps, index price for spot) - [createIntentAddress](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/createintentaddress.md): Create a bridge intent address for CCTP bridge - [fastbridge_info](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/fastbridge_info.md): Get fast bridge info - [deposit_latest](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/deposit_latest.md): Get most recent deposit for given l1 address - [deposit_networks](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/deposit_networks.md): Get networks that support deposits via intent address - [fastwithdraw](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/fastwithdraw.md): Fast withdraw - [fastwithdraw_info](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/fastwithdraw_info.md): Get fast withdraw info - [fundings](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/fundings.md): Get fundings. Maximum 750 fundings will be returned per call. `count_back` indicates the number of fundings you would like to be returned, starting from `start_timestamp`, if set to 0, all fundings will be returned. - [funding-rates](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/funding-rates.md): Get funding rates - [notification_ack](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/notification_ack.md): Ack notification - [referral_create](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/referral_create.md): Create referral code - [referral_points](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/referral_points.md): Get referral points - [referral_get](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/referral_get.md): Get referral code - [referral_kickback_update](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/referral_kickback_update.md): Update kickback percentage for referral rewards (allowed once per day) - [referral_update](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/referral_update.md): Update referral code (allowed once per account) - [referral_use](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/referral_use.md): Use a referral code. You can change this at a later time. - [userReferrals](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/referral_userreferrals.md): Get user referrals - [referral_stats](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/referral_stats.md): Get trade stats summed across a referrer's referred users - [info](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/info.md): Get info of zklighter - [exchangeStats](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/exchangestats.md): Get exchange stats - [exchangeMetrics](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/exchangemetrics.md): Get exchange metrics. When filtering by market, use the market symbol as a value. - [partnerStats](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/partnerstats.md): Get partner stats. If timestamps are not provided, all-time stats will be returned. - [executeStats](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/executestats.md): Get execute stats - [transferFeeInfo](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/transferfeeinfo.md): Transfer fee info - [withdrawalDelay](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/withdrawaldelay.md): Withdrawal delay in seconds - [tokenlist](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/tokenlist-1.md): Get token list and their metadata - [syntheticSpotInfo](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/syntheticspotinfo.md): Get synthetic spot info for a symbol. For complete details see: https://docs.lighter.xyz/trading/real-world-assets-rwas/us-equity-indices - [leaderboard](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/leaderboard.md): Get points leaderboard - [livePoints_total](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/livepoints_total.md): Get RH live points total for an account - [rfq_create](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/rfq_create.md): Create RFQ. Makers have up to 1 minute to answer an RFQ, after which the user has up to 2 minutes to execute the trade. Quotes are not locked. Makers place orders directly into the order book and can dynamically adjust pricing. - [rfq_respond](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/rfq_respond.md): Respond to RFQ. Makers have up to 1 minute to answer an RFQ, after which the user has up to 2 minutes to execute the trade. Quotes are not locked. Makers place orders directly into the order book and can dynamically adjust pricing. - [rfq_update](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/rfq_update.md): Update RFQ status - [rfq_get](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/rfq_get.md): Get RFQ by ID - [rfq_list](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/rfq_list.md): List RFQs - [leaseOptions](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/leaseoptions.md): Returns available lease duration/rate tiers, sorted by duration descending. - [leases](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/leases.md): Returns paginated lease entries for an account, most recent first. Supports read-only auth via signature/account_index/timestamp query params. - [litLease](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/litlease.md): Submit a LIT lease transfer. The server calculates the required fee based on lease_amount and duration_days, then executes the transfer. Fee formula (integer arithmetic): fee = lease_amount × (annual_rate × 100) × duration_days / (360 × 10000). - [Get Account Assets](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_accounts-param-assets.md) - [Get Account by Address](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_accounts-param-logs.md) - [Get Account by Address](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_accounts-param-positions.md) - [Get Recent Batches](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_batches.md) - [Get Batch by Id](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_batches-batchid.md) - [Get Recent Blocks](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_blocks.md) - [Get Block by Id](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_blocks-blockid.md) - [Get Log by Hash](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_logs-hash.md) - [List all markets](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_markets.md) - [Get Market Latest Logs. To query perpetual markets, use the symbol alone. For spot markets, use `symbol-quote` e.g. `eth-usdc`](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_markets-symbol-logs.md) - [Search for blocks, batches, transactions, or accounts](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_search.md) - [Get Tx Stats](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_stats-tx.md) - [List Total Values](https://apidocs.rh.lighter.xyz/reference/get_total.md)
